question: Who became the youngest speaker in the history of the Maharashtra State Assembly in July 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rahul Narwekar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra State Assembly is the lower house of the Maharashtra Legislature.**
 
• The Speaker of the Maharashtra State Assembly is elected by the members of the Assembly.
 
• The role of the Speaker is to maintain order and decorum in the house and to ensure that the proceedings are conducted in a fair and impartial manner.
 
• **Incumbent Rahul Narvekar is the Speaker of the Maharashtra Legislative Assembly from 3 July 2022.**
 
• **The Speaker is elected for a period of 5 years from among the members in the very first session of the Legislative Assembly after the general election.**
 
• In the absence of the Speaker, the sitting of the Maharashtra Legislative Assembly is presided over by the Deputy Speaker
 
• The Speaker may be removed from office by a resolution passed by an effective majority of the members of the Assembly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rahul Narwekar** became the youngest speaker in the history of the Maharashtra State Assembly in July 2022.
 
• Sajan Shah is not the correct option as he is not known to have held any political position in Maharashtra.
 
• **Sandeep Maheshwari** is a motivational speaker and entrepreneur and has no connection with the Maharashtra State Assembly.
 
• **Vivek Bindra is a business coach** and motivational speaker and has no connection with the Maharashtra State Assembly.
